description:
Start a contact pull run for a built audience. Requires audienceId from the build step and totalContacts from preview.
Set phoneValidation to true to also confirm each contact's phone number with a live phone call; it raises the price per contact from $0.05 to $0.19. The file is ready straight away with each phone marked "processing"; call results arrive over the following days, and downloading the run again returns them.
If logged in, the run is charged to the account's YourICP billing-token balance (5 billing tokens per contact, 19 with phoneValidation, where 100 billing tokens = $1.00) and returns a runId — call audience_download_run immediately after. Call check_billing_balance first if you want to tell the user the cost before spending.
If the balance is short, this returns error "mcp_insufficient_tokens" with required, available and shortfall counts — tell the user exactly how many tokens to top up at app.youricp.com and do NOT retry until they have. If it returns "mcp_no_billing_account", the client is not linked to an account yet and only support can fix it — do NOT retry.
If not logged in, card payment is required instead ($0.05 per contact, $0.19 with phoneValidation, capped at $1,000) — this tool returns a checkoutUrl and sessionId, then call check_payment, then audience_download_run with the runId. Card payments start at $0.50; below that it returns error "below_card_minimum" — suggest signing in instead.

audienceId.description: The audience id returned by the build step

phoneValidation.description: Also confirm each contact's phone number with a live phone call. Raises the price per contact from $0.05 to $0.19 (5 to 19 billing tokens).

totalContacts.description: total_contacts value from the preview result

name: audience_start_run
